book.name: Loum
book.title: Loum Poloye Loum sosee mapoo to hogugu tenee

content: Nemegei tei too odoo mapooto tokenee na takee
Esiga nima kulodu odoo tei too medee kibilega egee do ee emegei dolone ide. Osoloso dibada goo goolee opusomo opusomo di ee ogoloso dibolo toso na agadige.
Bei, tei too odoo heeso eyo goo goolee oso nei susuga ee nalai tekepo deliso. Esino tei too kibile poogoo odoo heeso eyo goo goolee oso gala hwei nalai tei deliso.

Esiga nei susuga nalai tekepo deli odoo oso see gala hwei nalai tei deli odoo mapoo gowoolai tekeponee. Osoloso see gala hwei nalai tei deli odoo oso nei susuga nalai tekepo deli odoo ee tokenee dalai tekeponee. Bei, Godeeye odoo nei susuga nali ee odoo tokenee dee koo takeli.

Esiga nimapoo kitulugu mauwe, niyo odoo heeyo tou teli odoo ee tokenee sisilei. Bei, hedebe o wiligi odoo oso o tou teli odoo eyo goo ee midileiso. Esiga o tou teli odoo oso Lodeeye pidi kitulugu maga o tou ee medee tekepo talaiso.

Osoloso see biame eyo goo maga odoo heeso egeesee takalai malaiso, “Biame hee ono diya tei dolone, nei biame abo ee tei mauwe,” dee takalai malaiso. Osoloso nei odoo heeso takolone, biame susuga ee hedebe, dee takalai malaiso. Egeesi ma kulodu goo hamaga odoo susuga oso dieso goolee maga dabalai tekepo.

Bei, biame hedebe mapoo tei deli odoo oso yo Lodee goolone ka seli. Osoloso nei susuga nali odoo oso yo Lodee goolone nei susuga naliso. Bei, yayo goomoga to Godee mapoo takoloso nei naliso. Osoloso gala hwei nalai tei deli odoo oso yo Lodee goolone, goomoga to Godee mapoo takoloso nei segei ono naliso.
Esiga mipoo hamapoo wulo iso goomoga goo ee tolone koo doso. Osoloso iyo wedilei onosee wulo iso goomoga goo maga koo wodumoloso.

Esino iyo mipoo hamapoo dobolone osoloso wedilone, Lodee mapoo goomoga goo tenelai tekepo. Esiga iyo mipoo toowa hamapoo egee do ee ma kulodu, osoloso iyo wedilei mapoo iba wulo Lodeeyo odoo doloso dabalaiso.
Goo egeesi maga Keliso toloso see gie badeli mapoo hogadiso, yayo odoo gie egee do sabolo osoloso odoo wedia dia wiligi odoo doloso badalame.

Esiga niyo bei kasalame nee tei too odoo ee tokenee ka sisiliyo? Osoloso see niyo bei kasalame nee tei too odoo ee ka goweliyo? Bei, iba susuga Godeeyo howo woola tebisileiso, yayo ibada goo midilame.
Bei, Godeeyo to booka mapoo hogugu oso egeesee takooso,

content.text: “A wiligi odoo, Lodee, kookaiyo gie badeli ee aso. Osoloso ayo tei goo egeesee takooso,
Odoo susuga oso mo homo beiyopoo gauwuloso takolone,
a tei Godeeso dolone dabalaiso,” dee takaso.

content: Esiga odoo hedebe hedebe di oso goo iso moodoo eyo bei ee Godee mapoo takalaiso.
Nayo nei nali goo maga nee odoo eetokenee mapoo na gido di
Esiga iyo ibada tei too odoo eyo goo ee ogoloso wulo goo gooleeso nei midi nei midi dee na soomo. Osoloso nee tei too odoo oso goo tokenee teyaga, niyo yo tagodibigilame goo hee na moodee.
Esiga Lodee Yesuye amapoo olo eligiso, nei susuga nalai ee tei mauwe. Esino odoo heeso takolone, nei abo nalai tei daga, yo nei egee nelega tei doloso osee badalai tekepo.

Egeesi ma kulodu nayo nei nolone dabalai goo oso nee tei too odoo mapoo hegi goo tonomologa, nayo odoo egee sooloo dolone koo seeso. Esino nayo nei susuga nolone egee bado goo oso nee odoo ee tokenee na peye dee. Bei, Kelisoye yo halo olo taso.
Niyo goolone goo hee ee tekepo dee gooleega, niba obeeyamo, nibada goo ee ogoloso, odoo aboso maneyaga.

Bei, Godeeye wiligi doloso badeli goo mapoo nei nalai sabolo, osoloso howo nalai sabolo oso goo toowa koo moloso. Esino Dio Tei oso kitulugu maga Godeeyo howo woola tekepo badalai goo sabolo, osoloso nee odoo sabolo mesie badalai goo sabolo, osoloso goomoga sabolo badalai goo oso goo toowa ka moloso.
Esiga edebeeyo goo egeesi ma kulodu badolone Keliso mapoo mesilone badoga, Godeeye odoo egee bia mapoo goomogalaiso. Osoloso odoo aboso yo odoo tekepo dalaiso.
Esiga iba mesie goo tosibilei goo ee tolone dabalame esilone ka dobomo. Osoloso ibada odoo oso tei too ma kulodu kitulugu sabolo badalame, nei pidi nei pidi dolone dobomo.

Esiga nei nayo nali oso Godeeye odoo hee ma kulodu tou too ee tokenee na peye dee. Nei susuga nalai tei mauwe. Esino nei susuga ee ma kulodu nayo nei hee ne oso nee tei too odoo ee goo tokenee mapoo gido duga, no goo tokenee toso. Esiga nayo yo halo nei egee na ne.

Egeesi ma kulodu nayo o howo woola gala hwei nelega pagalai tekepo, osoloso wain i nelega pagalai tekepo, osoloso goo abo moodelega pagalai, goo oso nee tei too odoo hee goo tokenee talame gido diyaga.

Egeesi ma kulodu nayo goolee oso nei susuga nalai tekepo daga, nei egee osee namalai tekepo. Esino nayo goolee oso nei abo nalai ono haga tekeponee dee gooleega, no wulo nei abo ee namalai tekepo. Nayo goo bakadio hamaga kasee gooleesomo, goo hagee hedebe nee goo, osoloso Godeeyo goo oso. Osoloso edebeeyo goo eyo tomo sili ee goo tekepo doloso gooleedoloso, o goo goolee oso goolee, yo goo tokenee tele, dee gooleega, yo goomogalai tekepo.

Esino edebeeyo goo goolee bakadio doloso badolone, nei susuga ee ma kulodu nei hee nalai ee tekeponee. Egeeseega Godeeye yimapoo goo tokenee to, dee takalaiso. Bei, yo tei telega goo egee ka toso. Esiga goo yayo tedeli goo mapoo tei telega poogoloso see toga, yo goo tokenee toso.
